vocab.sentence: This plastic bottle can be used again.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個塑膠瓶可以再次使用。
vocab.sentence_source: AI 補寫（課本例句遭裁切）

vocab.sentence: For your convenience, the store is open every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了方便你，這家店每天都有營業。
vocab.sentence_source: AI 補寫（課本例句遭裁切）

vocab.sentence: Rick is eagerly waiting for his boss to post the summer work schedule because he wants to plan his vacation.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rick 熱切等待老闆公布夏季工作表，因為他想安排假期。

vocab.sentence: The house is surrounded by tall trees, so nobody can see it from the road.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這棟房子被高樹包圍，因此從路上看不到它。

vocab.sentence: After the captain fell asleep, the ship passed the harbor and then drifted toward the middle of the sea.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 船長睡著後，船通過港口，接著漂向海中央。

vocab.sentence: Christopher really envies his best friend, Patty, because she has been to so many countries.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Christopher 很羨慕好友 Patty，因為她去過許多國家。

vocab.sentence: The Smith family is moving into a new house tomorrow, so their living room is crowded with boxes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Smith 一家明天要搬進新家，所以客廳堆滿了箱子。

vocab.sentence: Obviously, she likes this color.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 顯然，她喜歡這個顏色。

vocab.sentence: This shop sells a variety of health and food products for babies.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這家店販售各式嬰兒保健產品與食品。

vocab.sentence: Finishing his assignments consumes most of Riley's free time in the evening and on the weekend.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 完成作業耗掉 Riley 晚上與週末大部分的空閒時間。

vocab.sentence: Chocolate is delicious for most people, but did you know that it can be poisonous to dogs?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 巧克力對多數人來說很美味，但你知道它可能對狗有毒嗎？

vocab.sentence: The police found a strange substance in the box.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 警方在箱子裡發現一種奇怪的物質。
vocab.sentence_source: AI 補寫（課本例句遭裁切）

vocab.sentence: After the party, Nick took all the empty bottles out for recycling.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 派對結束後，Nick 把所有空瓶拿出去回收。

vocab.sentence: The cleaners were careful not to do any harm to the objects in the museum as they cleaned around them.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 清潔人員清理博物館物品周圍時，小心避免損傷物品。

vocab.sentence: It is every person's responsibility to save the earth's natural environment for our sons and daughters.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為下一代保護地球的自然環境，是每個人的責任。

vocab.sentence: Please use the recycling bins properly after the party.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 派對結束後，請正確使用回收桶。
vocab.sentence_source: AI 補寫（課本例句遭裁切）

phrases.sentence: Jane said she's not ready to join us yet, but she will come along later.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jane 說她還沒準備好加入我們，但晚點會到。

phrases.sentence: After Mr. Huang got fired, he sadly packed all of his things up and left.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 黃先生被解僱後，難過地收拾所有物品離開。

phrases.sentence: Lily loves to go fishing on her own, so she can listen to the sound of the sea.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Lily 喜歡獨自釣魚，這樣就能聆聽海的聲音。

phrases.sentence: The lion hid behind a tree for a while, waiting for a deer to walk by.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 獅子在樹後躲了一陣子，等待鹿走過。

phrases.sentence: We missed the bus and ended up walking home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們錯過公車，最後只好走路回家。
phrases.sentence_source: AI 補寫（課本例句遭裁切）
